title: Treasury 20-Year Bond (new issues and reopenings) auction results, Oct-2023 to Oct-2024
text:
U.S. Treasury 20-Year Bond (new issues and reopenings) auctions — results from October 2023 through October 2024.
Source: TreasuryDirect auction results API (www.treasurydirect.gov/TA_WS/securities/search), U.S. Department of the Treasury, public domain. Bid-to-cover ratio = total competitive and noncompetitive bids tendered divided by total accepted; indirect share = indirect bidder accepted / competitive accepted (a proxy for foreign and investment-fund demand).
